description: Denmark index of average earnings, manufacture of food, beverages and tobacco (private), spliced

description: Denmark index of average earnings, corporations and organisations (private sector), spliced
source: Statistics Denmark SBLON1 (y/y from 2017Q1), ILON12 (2006Q1-2016Q4), ILON2X (1994Q1-2005Q4)

description: Euro area (changing composition) HICP all items, monthly index

description: Euro area real compensation per employee growth (deflated by HICP)

description: Euro area real negotiated wage growth (deflated by HICP)
notes: real_yoy = 100*((1+w/100)/(1+p/100)-1); w = ECB negotiated wage indicator y/y (published as growth rate), p = y/y of quarterly-average HICP EA.

description: Euro area ECB wage tracker (negotiated wages incl. smoothed one-off payments), annual growth
source: ECB Data Portal (EWT, ECB wage tracker)
notes: Forward-looking: built from signed collective agreements, so it extends ~4 quarters beyond the latest official data (values beyond the current quarter are mechanical projections of already-agreed pay and are revised as new agreements arrive). Use as expectation of near-term wage growth. 2013Q1-.

description: Finland HICP all items, monthly index
notes: HICP on ECOICOP ver.2 (back-calculated by Eurostat); deflator for real wages.

description: Finland real wage growth: index of wage and salary earnings deflated by HICP

description: Finland index of wage and salary earnings, total economy
notes: Long chain index (1964-); latest quarters preliminary (*). Includes regular earnings, overtime and irregular supplements; excludes performance bonuses.

description: Norway average annual earnings, all employees (TBU basis)
notes: Level series underlying no_tbu_wage_growth_a (1970-).

description: Norway average monthly earnings, all employees, all industries (a-ordningen)

description: Norway CPI all items, annual average
source: SSB table 14710 (annual mean of monthly index, computed)

description: Norway CPI all items, monthly index

description: Norway index of average monthly earnings, manufacture of food products and beverages (spliced)

description: Norway index of average monthly earnings, manufacturing (spliced)

description: Norway frontfag wage norm: estimated annual wage growth in NHO manufacturing agreed at the settlement (frontfagsrammen)
source: TBU (NOU 2023:12 / TBU Feb-2024 report, table 1.3 'Frontfagsrammen'); NHO / Norsk Industri press releases 2024-2026
notes: Known in March/April of the year it applies to (forward-looking wage norm; hence negative lag vs year end). Explicit frame published since Holden III (NOU 2013:13); 2014-2023 from TBU table, 2024 5.2 (hovedoppgjør), 2025 4.4 (mellomoppgjør), 2026 4.4 (hovedoppgjør, agreed 12 Apr 2026).

description: Norway frontfag outcome: annual wage growth in NHO manufacturing in total (TBU)
source: TBU (table 'Frontfagsrammen', Resultat) 2014-2023; TBU press releases Feb-2025 (2024: 5.3) and Feb-2026 (2025: 5.1)
notes: 2024 and 2025 are TBU preliminary figures. Outcome minus frame = wage drift surprise.

description: Norway households' disposable income in constant 2015 prices, seasonally adjusted
notes: Sector h140000 = households (excl. NPISH). Includes dividend income, which is very volatile around tax changes (2005-06, 2016) - see no_hh_real_disp_inc_xdiv_sa_q. 1999Q1-.

description: Norway households' real disposable income excluding dividends, seasonally adjusted (computed)
notes: Nominal disposable income excl. dividends deflated with the implicit deflator of total disposable income (= household consumption deflator used by SSB). Preferred real income measure for Norway.

description: Norway QNA wages and salaries per full-time equivalent employee, manufacture of food products, beverages and tobacco
unit: NOK thousand per FTE per quarter
notes: Computed: wages and salaries (NOK mn, unadjusted) / full-time-equivalent employees (1000). Strong seasonality (holiday pay in Q2) -> use y/y changes. Longest quarterly total-economy wage measure for Norway (1995-). Revised with each QNA release.

description: Norway QNA wages and salaries per full-time equivalent employee, total economy
unit: NOK thousand per FTE per quarter
notes: Computed: wages and salaries (NOK mn, unadjusted) / full-time-equivalent employees (1000). Strong seasonality (holiday pay in Q2) -> use y/y changes. Longest quarterly total-economy wage measure for Norway (1995-). Revised with each QNA release.

description: Norway real earnings growth: average monthly earnings (a-ordningen) deflated by CPI
notes: real_yoy = 100*((1+w/100)/(1+p/100)-1); w = y/y of no_avg_monthly_earnings_q, p = y/y of quarterly-average CPI (2017-).

description: Norway real wage growth: QNA wages per FTE employee deflated by CPI

notes: real_yoy = 100*((1+w/100)/(1+p/100)-1); Annual: w = TBU årslønnsvekst, p = growth of annual-average CPI. Matches SSB's official real earnings change (table 14858 ReallonnEndring) to within 0.3 pp after rounding.

description: Norway annual wage growth, average for all employees (TBU årslønnsvekst)

notes: real_yoy = 100*((1+w/100)/(1+p/100)-1); As se_real_wage_yoy_q but p = y/y of quarterly-average KPIF (removes mortgage-rate effects, which dominated KPI in 2022-2024). MI's headline real wage measure uses KPIF.

description: Sweden wage growth, whole economy (short-term wage statistics / Konjunkturlönestatistik), outcome incl. preliminary values
source_query: Löneutveckling efter sektor/Loner_efter_sektor_manadsdata.px Sektor=Hela ekonomin Variabel=Utgående lön, definitiva och preliminära värden
